currentObjective: Build and operate independent ventures that create substantial durable economic value — validate by building, kill weak theses fast, only sprint what Thomas greenlights.

Screen filter learned 2026-09-03: if the vendor already ships its own modern replacement, the dated incumbent is a migration path, not a Harbor opening.

evidenceDecisions.title: Bullhorn → Latch (staffed sprint)
evidenceDecisions.evidence: Challenge red-team named risks (not a veto): Amplify Search & Match already occupies AI search on Pro/Max; Starter/Core leftover is Boolean/speed, not a missing search product; a Marketplace parser or CSV writeback into Bullhorn has no path to a staffing system of record. Occupancy of other staffing ATS is demand, not a kill.
evidenceDecisions.interpretation: Credible enough for a $0 validation sprint if the prototype is a new system of record — not a Marketplace overlay. Calder did not treat Challenge as a veto.
evidenceDecisions.decision: Thomas approved a validation sprint with adjustments; Wren owns Latch (search → candidate → job → submit as the beginning of a new system of record (SoR)). Interviews deferred; build continues at $0. No Proceed / Retarget / Kill yet — Challenge file remains risk input for later, not a close.

evidenceDecisions.title: Concur (closed class)
evidenceDecisions.evidence: Challenge aimed the then-staffed receipt-to-report prototype: wrong leftover may be Travel/policy/SI, not submit; card-first tools may have deleted the expense report; Concur already ships capture (ExpenseIt), so a camera-only demo is occupied leftover. Vendor also shipping NextGen / new report UI.
evidenceDecisions.interpretation: A Harbor T&E replacement against SAP’s own UI modernization is the wrong bet — not an occupancy kill of Ramp/Expensify, and not a Challenge veto of an open nomination.
evidenceDecisions.decision: Calder closed Concur as a sprint (2026-09-02). Do not recycle Concur.

evidenceDecisions.title: EMPTY screens (foothold ≠ destination SoR)
evidenceDecisions.evidence: When Scout returns EMPTY, Challenge does not invent a packet. Recurring reject class: leftover foothold that never becomes Harbor’s system of record — sheet/lookup/CSV overlays; vendor-own modern successors already shipping (e.g. Propello, Fusion, FieldRoutes); Harbor-path walls (RFP, kids’ data, closed same-destination markets).
evidenceDecisions.interpretation: Occupancy alone is not a kill. Empty is the honest result when no nomination clears destination-first.
evidenceDecisions.decision: Prefer EMPTY over weak overlay nominations. No invented sprint packets from empty hunts.

howItWorks: Mission — Substantial durable economic value inside the observation window; cash matters, but so do durable bets.
Method — Vulnerability-first discovery: disliked paid software → destination platform → entry wedge → cheap screen → deepen → challenge → memo → Thomas gate → build to learn.
Statuses — Operating / Building / Researching / Waiting on evidence / Waiting on human action / Paused (pipeline statuses Active / Sprint / Closed underneath). Continue and Watch are dead.
Human gate — Thomas approves sprint memos; Scout and Challenge kill weak ideas without him.
Ventures — Independent brands (Setaside is Setaside; Latch is Latch). Elephant Harbor stays parent/background.
Kill discipline — Closed names stay closed; reopen only on new evidence. Afterfee stays dead.
$0 default — Prototype locally; no outreach / identity / paid rails without escalate.
